general.title: 1. General Information
general.content: This Privacy Policy establishes the terms under which the Histour development team uses and protects the information provided by its users. This application has been developed as an academic and technological project. We are strongly committed to the data security of our user community.

collected.title: 2. Information Collected
collected.content: Our application may collect basic personal information essential for its operation, which includes:

bullets.name: • First and last name.
bullets.preferences: • In-app preferences (such as selected language, light/dark theme, and historical sites marked as "Favorites").

usage.title: 3. Use of Collected Information
usage.content: Histour uses the information exclusively to provide the best possible user experience, particularly to maintain an active record and personalize the navigation through the cultural wealth and historical routes of Jalisco. The data entered in this prototype is not shared with third parties, sold, or used for profit or external marketing.

control.title: 4. Control of your personal information
control.content: At any time you can manage the use of your personal information. As a user, you have the right and freedom to update your data, modify your login credentials, or request the permanent deletion of your account directly from the Settings menu in your Profile.

contact.title: 5. Contact and Data Controllers
contact.content: For any questions, suggestions, or clarifications regarding this privacy policy and data processing, you can contact the development team through the following emails:

intro.subtitle: History and tourism app
